scope: Fresh native finite-force trial of the sole -30 degree / COM[0,+0.0345]m candidate. A full-path two-handle 2mm frozen-clearance condition was tested and failed; that failed evidence is retained. Contact with the free back strap after entry into the cloth body is permitted for this physical experiment, not certified as a collision-free path.
unchanged_physical_requirements: Native FEM plus IPC self/soft/rigid contact; no pins, attachments, hidden supports or vertex manipulation
Original J>=0.05, cloth stretch<=1.15, table penetration<=2mm, holding/force/torque gates
Original robot 8mm and frozen teddy-left-robot 5mm route gates; continuous reference limits .35rad/s and .5rad/s2
Fresh actual-shape planning and pre-insertion reobservation; recenter_enabled=false
Final actual 3D whole-teddy and COM containment, retention and release/withdraw validation
why_contact_is_not_automatically_disqual: The task intentionally asks cloth and teddy to deform through physical contact. A frozen intersection involving an unheld flexible handle after the teddy has entered the body does not establish a native penetration or impossible motion. It is a risk to test with the actual collision solver, not a success prediction.
known_risks: The free handle may catch the teddy, displace the bag or prevent containment.
Hybrid source geometry is not one actual joint snapshot; actual full-run geometry may reject the route.
A nominal clearance certificate does not guarantee dynamic tracking, friction grasp, material realism or final containment.
required_before_native: Complete original robot and continuous rate review passed
Held front strap full-descent 2mm frozen gap and both straps pre-entry separation independently confirmed
Reviewed source/config hashes locked and fresh initialization used
